rule: 1.5x parity-replacement rule — replacement must be >=1.5x faster than the algorithm it replaces
parity_check: PASS — fast.merges() == naive.merges() at full workload
notes: Post-fix measurement after hoisting heap push out of per-word loop. Initial implementation pushed O(|pairs|) stale entries per affected word per merge, amplifying to ~10^8 pushes for common byte-pairs on large corpora → OOM on real 127 MB CSN-Python. Fix aggregates pairs_touched across all affected words and pushes once per pair per merge.
